definitions.explanation: A written text containing dialogue, stage directions, and other instructions for a play, film, or TV show.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}の{脚本|きゃくほん}は{素晴|すば}らしい。
examples.english: The screenplay for this movie is excellent.

examples.japanese: {脚本|きゃくほん}{家|か}を{目指|めざ}している。
examples.english: I'm aiming to become a screenwriter.

notes:
COMPOUND: {脚|きゃく} (leg, base) + {本|ほん} (book, script)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{脚本|きゃくほん}を{書|か}く (to write a script)
・{脚本|きゃくほん}{家|か} (screenwriter, playwright)
・{脚本|きゃくほん}{賞|しょう} (screenplay award)
・オリジナル{脚本|きゃくほん} (original screenplay)

RELATED TERMS:
・{台本|だいほん} (script - for TV/radio, more casual)
・シナリオ (scenario, screenplay)
・{演出|えんしゅつ} (direction, production)
・{監督|かんとく} (director)

CONTEXTS:
・{映画|えいが} (film)
・ドラマ (TV drama)
・{舞台|ぶたい} (stage play)
・アニメ (anime)
